scenario_summary: Customer is requesting a refund for a service canceled 34 days ago, which is outside the standard 30-day refund window.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Julio Perez and I'm 31. I'm trying to get a refund for a service I canceled 34 days ago. I know your refund policy is usually 30 days, but I was traveling and only just saw the charge — I didn't realize it had gone through until now. Is there anything you can do?
Okay, I see. Can you give me your account number so I can look that up?
Thanks. Look, our policy is pretty clear that refunds aren't allowed after 30 days. You said you canceled 34 days ago, so you're outside the window.
I understand that, but as I mentioned, I was traveling and didn't have access to my statements. Is there any way to make an exception since it's only a few days over?
I don't know, I guess I can try to escalate this to a supervisor. What was your account number again?
It's 8849201, like I just said a moment ago.
Right. Well, I'm just going to send this to the billing department queue. They handle these things. You'll hear back in 3-5 business days.

escalation_reason: Agent failed to exercise discretion or check for policy exceptions, instead offloading the request to the billing department due to lack of initiative.
